title: Rechargeable Coffee Scale with Timer, Diyife 3kg/0.1g High Precision Scale, 6 Units, HD LED Display, Long Battery Life, Portable Kitchen Scale for Espresso, French Press, Pour-Over Coffee
description:
About this item
【0.1g High Precision]】Diyife coffee scale is equipped with a high precision sensor to ensure accuracy in every measurement. It has an accuracy of 0.1 grams and a range of 0.3 grams to 3 kilograms. During the brewing process, the coffee scale is able to stabilize faster and respond sensitively to every 0.1 gram increase
【Two Timing Modes, 6 Units】Built-in automatic and manual timing modes with precise timing to keep the consistency of each cup of coffee. 6 valid measurement units can be switched at any time: g,oz,ml,lb, lb:oz , fl:oz to meet the weighing requirements of various ingredients such as solids or liquids. (Units cannot be switched when the coffee scale is in automatic timing mode)
【Rechargeable & Long Standby Time】The gram scale has a built-in hhigh-capacity lithium battery and a USB-C charging cable included in the package. No need to replace or buy batteries, it only takes 2-3 hours to fully charge and can be used for up to 90 days on a single charge. The coffee scale will automatically enter sleep mode after 5 minutes of inactivity to save power
【LED Display】Coffee scale with HD LED display, size 7.08*5.11*0.86 inches (18*13*2.2cm), the value is not easy to be obscured, can be seen from multiple angles, easy to store and carry. Suitable for most espresso machines and small coffee pots, also perfect for coffee lovers who like outdoor coffee
【High Quality Material】The surface of the digital coffee scale is made of tempered glass, drop and heat resistant, easy to clean and maintain. It is designed with a large arc to reduce collision. It features touch-sensitive controls with a seamless surface that enhances aesthetics and ensures waterproof and easy cleaning. Comes with removable silicone pads to protect the scale surface, waterproof, non-slip, anti-scratch and thermal insulation

reviews_5s:
Perfect size and easy to use for my espresso setup :)Hermosa grameraNice boxer, fit to size and comfy. Seem durable, time will tell.Diyife rechargeable, digital scale,

The intended use is as a coffee scale so you can weigh your beans and your coffee so you can do individual French press or Brew over coffee.

The scale will actually time how long it should take for you to get the Brew strength that you would like if you do a pour over coffee and how long it should take.

However this is a multi-use scale and it's a great digital scale that can go from ounces to milligrams.

Perfect for weighing out dried herbs, cheese, and other pantry items.

It comes with full directions which I would suggest reading in full. Because it is not an intuitive digital scale, due to the fact that there is a timer for brewing coffee as well as weighing and measuring.I bought this initially to weigh my coffee beans and shots. For those non caffeine addicted, to pull a standard espresso shot you usually need about 16 grams of beans, from that you should get about 40 grams of coffee. So an espresso scale needs to be small enough to fit under the machine as you weigh the coffee coming out.

This scale is perfect for pulling espresso shots. It's small enough to fit under the machine, it even has a timer for those that are doubly OCDed about their shots. I was surprised that it can weigh up to 6 pounds making it a great little kitchen / postage scale to have around.

It's very well made, has nice tough screen controls and is rechargeable. I really like it, if you need an espresso scale, I think this one is very good. I could not find fault with it.Excellent! Super accurate, has a mute button, looks chic, capacity up to 3000g which is ~6.6lb more than enough to accommodate pretty much any food or drink container as well as said food/liquid for measurement. Would highly recommend!We are loving this scale! We actually have not used it for coffee yet. We have been using it to weigh our food, and love it. The unit has some heft to it. It's not heavy, it just feels well made. I love the rubber pad it comes with. It keeps things from sliding and helps keep the unit clean. I really like that it is rechargeable with USB-C.
I will have to get a video and attach it later!Although it's designed for the "pour-over folks" it works just fine for other kitchen weighing tasks. Plus the rechargeable feature means never messing with changing batteries.I have been using this for my sourdough journey. I needed a scale that doesnt time out after a few seconds. This one is perfect! It fits nicely in a drawer. It is easy to clean and the buttons make sense. It can measure fl oz (not sure how but that's probably in the manual). So far so good!It arrived very nicely packaged, safe and secure. When I pulled it out of the box, I was surprised at the sturdiness. It has some weight to it. It’s very sleek looking with a gloss finish and soft touch buttons. Lightly tap and it’ll change units from oz, ml, fl oz, lbs, lbs and oz and so on. For power on and power off, press and hold a few seconds as shown in the video.

While I will use it for pour over coffee, this is also a perfect food scale! With all the different units of measurements, it’s versatile as all get out! Plus the internal battery is charged via USB-C and claims a 6 month charge on a single full charge. That’s amazing! This replaces my old scale which requires those little round batteries. The rubber mat to protect the scale and shield from heat is a perfect touch for coffee. Epic product!
